about_the_game:
Enter the void and face Bullet Hell vs Bullet Hell in an intense roguelite shoot 'em up experience. Void Resurgence puts you in command of a starfighter capable of unleashing as many bullets as the swarms of enemies flooding the screen.

Dodge and destroy in a symphony of projectiles as you fight through relentless incoming foes. Upgrade your ship on the fly and push your skills to the limit in this explosive arcade-style adventure.

Forge your path to victory by unlocking 20 distinct Core Systems. During each run, choose from these enhancements – from rapid-fire cannons and spread shots to energy shields and warp engines – to power up your arsenal.

Discover synergies as you combine Core Systems to unlock 16 game-changing Hyper Powers that unleash spectacular screen-clearing effects. No two runs are the same: experiment with different builds every session and experience a new combination of powers each time.

Choose from 10 unlockable ships, each with unique capabilities, and take down 10 formidable bosses across the galaxy. Four difficulty levels, from casual to hardcore, let you tailor the challenge to your skill level. Chase high scores and achievements as you master the game and climb the ranks.

Prove your prowess on Steam Leaderboards, which capture your score every 30 seconds of a run. Showcase your best combos and efficient destruction as you dominate the leaderboards and etch your name among the stars.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 (Mojave) or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel x64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 700 MB available space

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: 2 Ghz CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • Storage: 600 MB available space

short_description: Void Resurgence is a fast-paced top-down bullet hell roguelite shoot 'em up. Combine upgradeable Core Systems and unlock Hyper Power combos to create devastating builds, and survive relentless waves of enemies, bosses, and explosive arcade action.
